decisions.reason: The flagship Abendbrotkäse was promoted at launch and costs little to carry within the cheese range, but it was absent from the website in 2020 and 2021, so its option value is fading and not yet worth a further commitment.
The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the core range, so keeping it is cheap, and having no website visibility is not enough evidence on its own to abandon it.

Its sister washed-rind soft cheese was already withdrawn and this mild soft cheese has not appeared since 2018, which suggests its value is unlikely to be realized and its resources are better used in the core business.
